verdict.rationale: Cal.com's API v2 has documented REST endpoints covering the whole story. Developers can create event types with durations and booking fields, create schedules for availability, and query available slots. They can also create, reschedule and make instant bookings, subscribe to booking webhooks, and authenticate via API key or OAuth. Managed users and atoms explicitly target embedding scheduling into your own product. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented, and a published OpenAPI spec (probes of common spec paths returned 404).
